explication: FastRTC turns Python handlers into real-time audio/video sessions: users connect through a built-in Gradio UI or mounted WebRTC/WebSocket endpoints, media reaches a handler, and generated media or messages return to the client. Audio turn-taking, speech conversion, and phone access are documented capabilities. The graph covers the Python runtime and sampled frontend components; bundled Mermaid assets are included because they are substantial indexed modules. Some links rely on README or SOURCE INDEX references rather than inspected implementation details.
